selection: Within each outer repetition/cohort/predictor/protocol, minimize validation mean normalized partial AURC over 70%-90% coverage at lambda=20. SHR uses complete moment bounds during validation and evaluation. Ties use candidate ID.
controls: Controlled ablations inherit the full SHR selected XGBoost configuration; vary only the named component and capacity. Reference gate remains rho0=.01 and is not tuned to test results.
prescribed_baselines: Linear LossRej is unregularized OLS with no regularization search. SelRej architecture and fitting objective remain fixed, with validation-selected learning rate and training duration.
penalty: Choose heads once at lambda=20; vary lambda and alpha without refitting for sensitivity.
scope: Exploratory comparison on previously studied benchmarks; no independent confirmatory trial.
reuse: Within a configuration, all selectors use the same fitted RUL predictors and queries; repeat-level partitions and validation candidate grids are specified here.
